results: 1. Observe the patient's gait and posture
posture and pull test: about 70 degrees of leftward trunk tilt on walking with antecollis; normal stance and tilt disappears when recumbent
gait observation including turning and doorways: not recorded
2. Perform a comprehensive neurological examination including tone, power, reflexes, coordination, and sensory testing
cranial nerve examination: dysarthria, dysphagia, broken pursuit eye movements and orofacial dyskinesia
muscle tone examination: normal limb and neck tone with leftward truncal dystonic flexion and antecollis
deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses: normal reflexes and flexor plantar responses
coordination examination (limb and truncal): chorea and orofacial dyskinesia; limb coordination normal
3. Assess for extrapyramidal signs (rigidity, tremor, bradykinesia)
limb rigidity and axial (neck) rigidity: not recorded
finger tapping for bradykinesia and decrement: normal
tremor characterisation (rest, postural, action): no tremor
